summary: ISO 68-1 basic-profile derivation of M2 x 0.4 reproduces the published table: d2 1.740192 (published 1.740), d3 1.509252 (1.509), D1 1.566987 (1.567), As 2.073233 mm2 (2.07, delta 0.0033). The coefficients 0.649519 / 1.226869 / 1.082532 were computed from H = P*sqrt(3)/2 inside compat.thread_geometry(), not typed in, so the agreement is an independent check and not a restatement. Same derivation shape as threaded-m3 row 0001, at the M2 size.
by: claude (microduck connections lane), compat.py run under python3 stdlib

summary: ISO 261 coarse pitch for nominal 2 mm is 0.4 mm and this connection encodes 0.4. Cross-checked against ce-cad/cecad/fasteners.py line 57 M2 row (pitch 0.40, tap 1.60, close clearance 2.20, cbore 4.4) and ce-parts/screw-m2-iso4762 (spec read off the fasteners.eu ISO 4762 page fetched 2026-08-19, per its component.json origin_why). compat.compatible() FAILs any pair declaring a different pitch, including M2 x 0.25 fine; mate.py refuses it too (watched refusing in its __main__ self-test 2026-09-02).
by: claude (microduck connections lane), read from cecad/fasteners.py and ce-parts/screw-m2-iso4762

summary: THE MICRODUCK IS AN M2 SYSTEM, measured not asserted: SPEC.md section 4's community hole census over Pollen's meshes counts Ø2.2 clearance x77, Ø4.4 c'bore x28, Ø1.6 tap x20 — landing exactly on the fasteners.py M2 row's close clearance (2.20), counterbore (4.4) and tap drill (1.60). On 2026-09-02 the microduck ce-parts shelf declared 60+ interfaces with accepts connection:threaded-m2 (ankle, foot, power-support, trunk-base, both trunk shells, both upper legs, rigidity plate, yaw2roll, bearing-roll, neck plate, motor support, banana-pcb-locker), each quoting its own measured hole diameter.
by: claude (microduck connections lane), scan of ce-parts/*/current/cad/interfaces.json

summary: TIGHTENING TORQUE, PRELOAD AND PLA PULL-OUT ARE NOT KNOWN and are not being estimated. The torque-preload relation is implemented in compat.preload_from_torque() with NO default for mu_thread, mu_bearing or d_km_mm (same refusal as threaded-m3 row 0004 — an assumed mu moves the answer >2x). The Microduck adds a second gap: most of its M2s form their own thread in printed PLA pilots (Ø1.55-1.65 measured on power_support / foot / trunk-shell / yaw2roll meshes) and no pull-out or strip torque of such a joint has been measured in this workshop. A bench pull-out with a scale would close this row and earn T2.
